definitions.explanation: A color between yellow and green, like the color of new leaves in spring or a lime. One of the traditional Japanese color names and one of the standard crayon colors.

examples.japanese: {新芽|しんめ}は{黄緑|きみどり}{色|いろ}をしている。
{黄緑|きみどり}のクレヨンで{葉|は}っぱを{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I colored the leaves with a yellow-green crayon.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{山|やま}が{黄緑|きみどり}から{深|ふか}い{緑|みどり}へと{変|か}わっていく。
examples.english: When spring comes, the mountains gradually change from yellow-green to deep green.

notes:
{黄緑|きみどり} is a standard Japanese color name for the color between yellow and green, like new spring leaves or a lime.

FORMS:
{黄|き} (yellow) + {緑|みどり} (green).
- {黄緑|きみどり}: as a noun (the color itself)
- {黄緑|きみどり}{色|いろ}: as a modifier (yellow-green colored)
- {黄緑|きみどり}の: modifying a noun

USAGE:
- Art supplies: クレヨンや{色|いろ}{鉛筆|えんぴつ}の{黄緑|きみどり} (yellow-green crayon/colored pencil)
- Nature: {新芽|しんめ}の{黄緑|きみどり} (the yellow-green of new buds)
- Clothing and design

RELATED COLORS:
- {緑|みどり}: green
- {黄色|きいろ}: yellow
- {若草色|わかくさいろ}: young grass green (a traditional, more poetic name for a similar shade)
- {萌黄|もえぎ}{色|いろ}: another traditional name for yellowish-green
